title: Event Management System
subtitle: Full-Stack MERN Event Discovery & Registration Platform
problemStatement: Event organizers often struggle with disjointed tools for ticketing, seat tracking, and registrant authentication, causing unnecessary friction and database confusion during live events.
solution: Engineered a scalable full-stack web application featuring secure JWT authentication, dynamic categorization, real-time ticket availability checking, and instant registrant verification.
architecture: RESTful Express/Node.js API communicating with a schema-driven MongoDB Atlas database. Frontend crafted with React and Tailwind CSS for seamless admin dashboards and student registrations.
keyLearnings: Mastered robust state management and token-based authentication workflows.
Optimized MongoDB indexing for rapid query execution during peak event registration spikes.
Structured reusable frontend components to maintain strict UI consistency.

title: AI Marketing Campaign Planner
subtitle: Intelligent Platform for Automated Strategy & Content Architecture
problemStatement: Generating comprehensive marketing roadmaps, audience demographic insights, and multi-channel ad copy traditionally requires countless hours of repetitive manual research and brainstorming.
solution: Built an AI-powered campaign generating suite utilizing Google's Gemini AI models to instantly output tailored buyer personas, budget allocations, and scheduled multi-channel content timetables.
architecture: Vite + React + TypeScript single-page app integrated with an Express proxy server orchestrating structured calls to the Gemini API with strict schema enforcement and error boundaries.
keyLearnings: Designed reliable prompt engineering templates for predictable JSON generation via LLMs.
Integrated secure server-side AI key management and streaming feedback indicators.
Implemented responsive data visualization cards for marketing analytics.

title: Personal Instructor & AI Portfolio
subtitle: Interactive Classroom-Style Web Platform with Embedded AI DSA Mentor
problemStatement: Traditional static resumes and recruiter portfolios fail to convey an instructor's genuine teaching philosophy, mentoring warmth, and practical algorithmic problem-solving ability to learners.
solution: Architected a student-first interactive web portfolio engineered for speed and accessibility, featuring an integrated AI DSA Mentor trained specifically to guide beginners through C++ concepts.
architecture: Modern SPA powered by React 19, TypeScript, and Vite. Implements WCAG AA accessible color palettes, Framer Motion micro-animations, and serverless conversational endpoints.
keyLearnings: Established an immaculate design system optimized specifically for readability and learner motivation.
Engineered conversational AI fallback boundaries to guarantee zero downtime during classroom demos.
Achieved stellar performance and SEO audits via code-splitting and semantic structure.
